## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that addresses it.
Link the issue or discussion, if any.

## Evidence

State the checks you ran and what remains untested. For UI changes, include
before/after screenshots and the viewport/language. Redact personal information.
For controller changes, distinguish automated checks from physical device testing.

## Compatibility and provenance

Note changes to input ownership, mapper restoration, startup, permissions or
dependencies. Identify borrowed code/assets and their license, if any.
